description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. County road-surface-history records describe right-of-way moratoriums using road number, begin/end measures, pavement year/date, material and moratorium end date. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. This is a restriction/history representation based on CRAB Mobility records. It does not itself establish current legal applicability or pavement condition. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
